releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.54 — groups get mentions and private replies. Type @ in a group and the member list appears; tap a name and it is inserted, and in the sent message every @Name from the roster is highlighted (stronger when it is you). A stray @ followed by ordinary words stays plain text, because only real member names light up. Long-press a group message from someone you are friends with and choose Reply privately: the message is copied into their direct chat, so the conversation moves out of the group without anyone else reading it. Long-press menus also stay inside the screen now — the card sizes itself from the actions it is actually showing.
